name: SenseNova-SI-1.1-InternVL3-8B-800K
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Spatial-intelligence fine-tune of OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B trained on the SenseNova-SI-800K subset only (the full SenseNova-SI-8M run is a separate record). Same InternVL3-8B architecture and tensor set: 0.45B vision encoder + 7.94B LLM, 28 layers, 32768 context. Recorded because the card prints base and this checkpoint as rows of one HTML table: VSI 42.1 -> 60.9, MMSI 28.0 -> 36.4, MindCube-Tiny 41.5 -> 56.9, ViewSpatial 38.6 -> 52.5, SITE 41.1 -> 47.7. It beats the base on all five, but trails the full-data sibling (68.7 / 43.3 / 85.6 / 54.6 / 47.7) everywhere except SITE, which ties. CAVEAT the card states itself: released solely for research and scaling-law analysis and explicitly 'not the primary recommended model', so it is a data-scaling reference point rather than the vendor's own best. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-12-17.
